safi-cedvel:24-24.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun in the position of the nominative (fī maḥall rafʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "معذّبون" (they will be punished) [Note: It may be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم", the clause being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) ... just as it may be a badal (substitute) for (كلّ مختال) in the previous verse (23).], (بالبخل) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأمرون). (الواو) a conjunction. (من) a conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (هو) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: Or a detached pronoun as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الغنيّ, and the clause is the khabar of إنّ.].
The clause «الذين يبخلون ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يبخلون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «يأمرون ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause. The clause «من يتولّ ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يتولّ ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.]. The clause «إنّ الله ... الغنيّ» is in the position of the jussive (fī maḥall jazm) as the apodosis [Note: The clause may be a causal explanation (taʿlīl) for an omitted apodosis, i.e.: whoever turns away, Allah is free of need of him, because Allah is the Free of need.]

safi-cedvel:25-25.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (بالبيّنات) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object or from the agent. (الواو) a conjunction in the following places. (معهم) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to a ḥāl from الكتاب, i.e. "carried with them". (اللام) for causation (taʿlīl). (يقوم) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām. (بالقسط) attached to (يقوم), by its being made to imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of "يتعاملون" (they deal with one another) ...
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يقوم ...) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزلنا، أرسلنا). (فيه) attached to an advanced khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (بأس). (للناس) attached to (منافع). (ليعلم) like ليقوم. (رسله) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the absent pronoun in (ينصره). (بالغيب) attached to a ḥāl from the pronoun in ينصره..
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause is resumptive. The clause «أنزلنا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the response to the oath. The clause «يقوم الناس ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن). The clause «أنزلنا (the second)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أنزلنا (the first). The clause «فيه بأس ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from الحديد. The clause «يعلم الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second implied particle-relative (أن), and the interpreted maṣdar (أن يعلم ...) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزلنا الحديد); and it is conjoined to an implied maṣdar, i.e. "ليستعملوه وليعلم ..." (that they may use it and that He may know ...).
The clause «ينصره ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من). The clause «إنّ الله قوي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

safi-cedvel:26-27.t:
* I'rab:
(ولقد أرسلنا) its i'rab has preceded [Note: In the previous verse (25).]. (الواو) a conjunction in the four places. (في ذرّيتهما) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), placed first. (الفاء) for subdivision (tafrīʿ). (منهم) attached to an advanced khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (مهتد), which is nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the deleted yāʾ, as it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ). And the second (منهم) is a naʿt (adjective) of (كثير).
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath ... and the implied oath clause is resumptive. The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath. The clause «منهم مهتد ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «كثير منهم فاسقون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause منهم مهتد.
27- (على آثارهم) attached to (قفّينا), and likewise (برسلنا). (بعيسى) attached to the second (قفّينا). (في قلوب) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi. (رهبانية) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to رأفة by the wāw [Note: Or it is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb by ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), explained by the mentioned verb, i.e.: ابتدعوا رهبانيّة.]. (ما) negative. (عليهم) attached to (كتبناها). (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr). (ابتغاء) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (manṣūb). (الفاء) a conjunction in the two places. (حقّ) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is annexed to the maṣdar. (منهم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of آمنوا, and the second (منهم) is a naʿt of (كثير).
The clause «قفّينا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause جعلنا. The clause «قفّينا (the second)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause قفّينا (the first). The clause «آتيناه ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause قفّينا (the second). The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause آتيناه. The clause «ابتدعوها» is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of رهبانية. The clause «ما كتبناها ...» is in the position of the accusative as a second naʿt of رهبانيّة. The clause «رعوها ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause كتبناها. The clause «آتينا ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause ما رعوها. The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «كثير ... فاسقون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, carrying the meaning of explaining the cause (taʿlīl) of their failure to observe it.

* Morphology:
(27) رهبانيّة: a noun of relation (ism mansūb) to الرهبان (the monks), so it is of the type of the artificial maṣdar (al-maṣdar al-ṣināʿī); or it is originally a maṣdar meaning ascetic discipline, withdrawal from people and becoming a monk; its pattern is فعلانيّة, with fatḥa then sukūn. (رعوها) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is رعاوها: two vowelless letters met, so the alif, the lām (third radical) of the word, was deleted, and it became رعوها, and what precedes the wāw remained with fatḥa as an indication of the deleted alif; its pattern is فعوها ...
(رعايتها) an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb رعي, meaning "to guard and manage affairs"; its pattern is فعالة, with kasra on the fāʾ.
[Translator's note: The source writes the verb as «رعي»; the usual form is رعى.]

* Benefits:
- The single wāw..
It is divided into the following kinds:
1- The conjunctive wāw (al-ʿāṭifa), whose meaning is absolute combination, as in His saying, Exalted is He: فَأَنْجَيْناهُ وَأَصْحابَ السَّفِينَةِ, and وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنا نُوحاً وَإِبْراهِيمَ.
2- That it be in the meaning of the bāʾ of the genitive, as in their saying: (أنت أعلم ومالك), i.e. بمالك (you know best about your property).
3- The wāw of resumption (al-istiʾnāf), after which the verb is nominative, as in His saying, Exalted is He: لِنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْأَرْحامِ ما نَشاءُ.
4- The wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial), which enters upon the nominal clause, e.g.: (جاء زيد والشمس طالعة) (Zayd came while the sun was rising).
5- The wāw of accompaniment (al-maʿiyya): the noun after it is accusative as a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), e.g.: (سرت والجبل) (I travelled along the mountain); or the imperfect verb after it is accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن, as in the poet's saying:
لا تنه عن خلق وتأتي مثله ... عار عليك إذا فعلت عظيم
(Do not forbid a trait while you do the like of it; a great shame is upon you if you do.)
6- The wāw of the oath, which enters only upon an overt noun and is attached only to an omitted verb, its implied form being "أقسم" (I swear), as in His saying, Exalted is He: وَالْعَصْرِ إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ.
7- The wāw of (ربّ), as in the saying of Imruʾ al-Qays:
وليل كموج البحر أرخي سدوله ... علي بأنواع الهموم ليبتلي
(And many a night like the waves of the sea has let down its curtains upon me with all kinds of cares, to test me.) And it enters only upon an indefinite noun.
8- The redundant (zāʾida) wāw, as in His saying, Exalted is He: حَتَّى إِذا جاؤُها فُتِحَتْ أَبْوابُها.
9- The wāw of the masculine pronoun, e.g.: (قاموا) (they stood); it is sometimes used for non-rational beings, as in His saying, Exalted is He: يا أَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوا مَساكِنَكُمْ.
10- The wāw that comes to lengthen the ḍamma (wāw al-ishbāʿ), as in the poet's saying:
جازيتموني بالوصال قطيعة ... شتّان بين صنيعكم وصنيعي
(You repaid my keeping in touch with severance; how far apart are your deed and mine!)
The point of evidence is the wāw in (جازيتموني).

safi-cedvel:28-29.t:
* I'rab:
(أيّها) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. (الذين) a relative noun in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) for أيّ — or as ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it. (الواو) a conjunction in the three places. (برسوله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنوا). (يؤتكم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the response to the imperative. (من رحمته) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (كفلين). (يجعل) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (يؤتكم), and likewise (يغفر). The first (لكم) is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the second is attached to (يغفر). (به) attached to (تمشون); the bāʾ is causal, and the verb is made to imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of "تهتدون" (you are guided). (الواو) resumptive.
The vocative clause «النداء ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «اتّقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative. The clause «يؤتكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ. The clause «يجعل ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause يؤتكم. The clause «تمشون ...» is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of (نورا) [Note: Or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in (لكم), its governing word being يجعل.]. The clause «يغفر ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause يؤتكم. The clause «الله غفور ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
29- (اللام) for causation (taʿlīl). (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (لا) redundant (zāʾida). (ألّا) lightened from the heavy (أنّ) [Translator's note: i.e. the أن contained in ألّا.], its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), omitted [Note: Its noun may be a pronoun referring to the People of the Book, i.e. that they have no power over anything of Allah's bounty.], and (لا) is negative. (على شيء) attached to (يقدرون). (من فضل) attached to a naʿt of (شيء) ... (بيد) attached to the khabar (predicate) of أنّ. The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعلم ...) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, i.e.: "أعلمكم بذلك ليعلم ..." (I have informed you of that so that ... may know).
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا يقدرون ...) is in the position of the accusative, filling the place of the two objects of يعلم. The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الفضل بيد ...) is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar ألّا يقدرون ...
The clause «يعلم أهل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن). The clause «يقدرون ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the lightened (أن). The clause «يؤتيه ...» is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of (أنّ). The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من). The clause «الله ذو الفضل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive and explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).

safi-cedvel:1-6.t:
* I'rab:
(لله) attached to (سبّح) [Note: The lām may be for causation, as above, and it may be redundant for emphasis, as one says "I thanked him" and "I advised you"; then the divine name is genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi], (ما) relative, in the position of nominative, fāʿil (في السموات) attached to an omitted element, ṣila of ما, (الواو) circumstantial (الحكيم) second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو).
Clause: «سبّح لله ما في السموات ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «هو العزيز ... » is in the position of accusative, ḥāl [Note: it may be resumptive, with no grammatical position]. 2- 3- (له) attached to an omitted element, a preceding khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ملك), (الواو) conjunction in both places (على كلّ) attached to (قدير) (بكلّ) attached to (عليم). Clause: «له ملك السموات ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «يحيى ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption [Note: it may be in the position of accusative, ḥāl from the pronoun in (له), the operator in it being "being settled" (istiqrār)]. Clause: «يميت ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يحيي. Clause: «هو ... قدير» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يحيي. Clause: «هو الأول ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «هو ... عليم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو الأوّل. 4- (في ستة) attached to (خلق), (على العرش) attached to (استوى), (ما) relative, in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi (في الأرض) attached to (يلج), (ما) the second, conjoined to the first, in the position of accusative (منها) attached to (يخرج), (ما) the third, conjoined to the first, and likewise (ما) the fourth ... in the position of accusative (من السماء) attached to (ينزل), (فيها) attached to (يعرج), because it is made to contain the meaning "enters" (معكم) accusative adverbial, attached to an omitted element, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو), (أين ما) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, adverb of place, attached to the content of the apodosis [Note: or attached to the full verb كنتم ... By right (أين ما) should be written joined, but it was written separated in the muṣḥaf], (كنتم) a full past verb, in the position of jussive, protasis (ما) a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of genitive, its returning pronoun omitted, i.e. "what you do", and the clause after it is the ṣila] ...
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون ... ) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (بصير). Clause: «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «خلق ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذي). Clause: «استوى ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خلق. Clause: «يعلم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: it may be in the position of accusative, ḥāl from the fāʿil of خلق and استوى]. Clause: «يلج ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the first relative (ما). Clause: «يخرج ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the second relative (ما). Clause: «ينزل ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the third relative (ما). Clause: «يعرج ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the fourth relative (ما). Clause: «هو معكم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the preceding resumptive. Clause: «كنتم ... » has no grammatical position, parenthetical ... The apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. Clause: «الله ... بصير» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو معكم. Clause: «تعملون ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle-relative (ما). 5- 6- (له ملك) like the first (الواو) conjunction (إلى الله) attached to (ترجع), (في النهار) attached to the first (يولج), (في الليل) attached to the second (يولج) (الواو) conjunction (بذات) attached to (عليم) ...
Clause: «له ملك ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «ترجع الأمور ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause له ملك ...
Clause: «يولج الليل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «يولج النهار ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يولج (the first). Clause: «هو عليم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive.

* Morphology:
(4) يلج: it has an iʿlāl by deletion; it is a mithāl weak verb, its fāʾ deleted in the imperfect; its past is ولج; its wazn is يعل. (6) الصدور: plural of الصدر ... the name of the well-known organ (the chest); its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, and الصدور is فعول with ḍamma.

* Rhetoric:
Kināya (metonymy): in the saying of the Exalted وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ ما كُنْتُمْ.
It is a kināya for Allah, Glorified and Exalted, encompassing their words, deeds and all their states, because one present with a people has nothing of that hidden from him; so it was expressed as His being with them, intending what necessarily follows from that, namely His awareness of all their states. Thus the entailed was stated and the entailing was intended.

safi-cedvel:7-7.t:
* I'rab:
(بالله) attached to (آمنوا), (ممّا) attached to (أنفقوا), (فيه) attached to (مستخلفين), (الفاء) causal (منكم) attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of آمنوا (لهم) attached to a preceding khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أجر). Clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «أنفقوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive. Clause: «جعلكم ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (ما). Clause: «الذين آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, causal. Clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذين). Clause: «أنفقوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause. Clause: «لهم أجر ... » is in the position of nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).

* Morphology:
(مستخلفين), plural of مستخلف, a passive participle from the sextiliteral استخلف; its wazn is مستفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:8-8.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (ما) an interrogative noun, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (لكم) attached to an omitted element, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (لا) negative (بالله) attached to (تؤمنون), (الواو) circumstantial (اللام) for causation (تؤمنوا) imperfect, accusative by an implied أن after the lām (بربّكم) attached to (تؤمنوا), (الواو) wāw of ḥāl (قد) a particle of certainty (كنتم) an incomplete past verb, in the position of jussive, protasis. The interpreted maṣdar (أن تؤمنوا ... ) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يدعوكم). Clause: «ما لكم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «لا تؤمنون ... » is in the position of accusative, ḥāl from the pronoun in (لكم). Clause: «الرسول يدعوكم ... » is in the position of accusative, ḥāl from the pronoun in (لكم). Clause: «يدعوكم ... » is in the position of nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الرسول). Clause: «تؤمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن). Clause: «أخذ ... » is in the position of accusative, ḥāl from ربّكم. Clause: «كنتم مؤمنين ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive ... The apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "so hasten to believe in Him".

safi-cedvel:9-10.t:
* I'rab:
(على عبده) attached to (ينزّل), (اللام) for causation (من الظلمات) attached to (يخرجكم) and likewise (إلى النور). The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخرجكم ... ) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (ينزّل) (الواو) conjunction (بكم) attached to the khabar (رؤف), (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis. Clause: «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «ينزّل ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذي). Clause: «يخرجكم ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن). Clause: «إنّ اللَّه ... لرؤوف» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive. 10- (الواو) resumptive - or conjunction - (ما لكم) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (8) of this sūra], (أن) a maṣdar particle (لا) negative (في سبيل) attached to (تنفقوا) the negated.. The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا تنفقوا..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to a ḥāl from the pronoun in (لكم), i.e.: "What is the matter with you, persisting in not spending?" (الواو) circumstantial (للَّه) attached to a preceding khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ميراث), (لا) negative (منكم) attached to a ḥāl from the relative (من), fāʿil of يستوي (من قبل) attached to (أنفق), (درجة) tamyīz, accusative (من الذين) attached to (أعظم), (بعد) a noun of time, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of genitive by (من), attached to (أنفقوا), (الواو) conjunction in both places (كلّا) preceding mafʿūl bihi (الحسنى) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (ما) a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of genitive, its returning pronoun omitted] ...
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون ... ) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (خبير). Clause: «ما لكم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: or conjoined to the clause ما لكم لا تؤمنون - in verse (8) - with what lies between them being parenthetical]. Clause: «تنفقوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle-relative (أن). Clause: «للَّه ميراث ... » is in the position of accusative, ḥāl. Clause: «لا يستوي منكم من ... » has no grammatical position, causal. Clause: «أنفق ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (من). Clause: «قاتل ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنفق. Clause: «أولئك أعظم درجة ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption. Clause: «أنفقوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذين). Clause: «قاتلوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنفقوا. Clause: «وعد اللَّه ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أولئك أعظم ...
Clause: «اللَّه ... خبير» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause وعد اللَّه. Clause: «تعملون» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).

* Rhetoric:
1- Omission (ḥadhf): in the saying of the Exalted وَما لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنْفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ.
The object of «تنفقوا» is omitted to intensify the rebuke, i.e.: "What is it that you have in not spending on that which brings one near to Allah the Exalted?"
2- Omission: in the saying of the Exalted لا يَسْتَوِي مِنْكُمْ مَنْ أَنْفَقَ مِنْ قَبْلِ الْفَتْحِ وَقاتَلَ.
The counterpart of "the one who spent" is omitted, because it is evident and what follows indicates it; the estimation is: "Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest of Mecca and the strength of Islam and those who spent after the conquest."

safi-cedvel:11-14.t:
* I'rab:
(من) an interrogative noun, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (ذا) a demonstrative, in the position of nominative, khabar [Note: (من ذا) may be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is (الذي), and then it is written joined (منذا)], (الذي) relative, in the position of nominative, badal from ذا (قرضا) mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative (الفاء) the fāʾ of causality (يضاعفه) imperfect, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ, and the fāʿil is "he", i.e. Allah (له) attached to (يضاعفه), (له) the second, a preceding khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ (أجر) ...
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يضاعفه ... ) is in the position of nominative, conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding interrogative, i.e.: "Is there a loan from you to Allah, and so a multiplication of it from Him for you in repayment ..."
Clause: «من ذا الذي ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «يقرض ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذي). Clause: «يضاعفه ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن). Clause: «له أجر ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يضاعفه. 12- (يوم) accusative adverb of time, attached to the "being settled" to which (له) is attached [Note: or attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "they are rewarded" ... and it may be a mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" ...], (بين) accusative adverbial, attached to (يسعى) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl from (نورهم)] (بأيمانهم) attached to what the adverbial بين is attached to, so it is conjoined to it (بشراكم) mubtadaʾ, nominative (اليوم) accusative adverbial, attached to an implied verb, i.e. "it is said to them: your glad tidings" (جنّات) khabar of the mubtadaʾ, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "entering gardens" (من تحتها) attached to (تجري) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl from الأنهار] and in it an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "from beneath their trees".. (خالدين) accusative ḥāl from the latent pronoun in the implied muḍāf, i.e. "your entering gardens, abiding therein" [Note: the maṣdar بشراكم may not govern the ḥāl, because an outsider - the khabar - stands between it and what it governs], (فيها) attached to (خالدين), (هو) pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: it may be a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الفوز, and the clause is the khabar of the demonstrative] ..
Clause: «ترى ... » is in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. Clause: «يسعى نورهم ... » is in the position of accusative, ḥāl from المؤمنين. Clause: «بشراكم ... » is in the position of accusative, the quoted speech of an implied saying, i.e. "the angels say to them". Clause: «تجري ... » is in the position of nominative, naʿt of جنّات. Clause: «ذلك ... الفوز ... » has no grammatical position, parenthetical [Note: the demonstrative in the sentence refers to the light and the glad tidings of the gardens ... or to the Garden.] 13- (يوم) an adverbial, badal from the first يوم (للذين) attached to (يقول), (نقتبس) imperfect, jussive, response to the command (من نوركم) attached to (نقتبس), (وراءكم), accusative adverb of place, attached to (ارجعوا), (الفاء) conjunction in both places (بينهم) accusative adverbial attached to (ضرب), (بسور) nāʾib fāʿil (له) attached to a preceding khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ (باب), and likewise (فيه) khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الرحمة) and (من قبله) khabar of the mubtadaʾ (العذاب).
Clause: «يقول المنافقون ... » is in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. Clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذين). Clause: «انظرونا ... » is in the position of accusative, the quoted speech. Clause: «نقتبس» has no grammatical position, apodosis of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ. Clause: «قيل» has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «ارجعوا» is in the position of nominative, nāʾib fāʿil [Note: because it is originally the quoted clause.] Clause: «التمسوا ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause ارجعوا. Clause: «ضرب ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumptive, i.e. "so they returned, and so a wall was set up ..."
Clause: «له باب ... » is in the position of genitive, naʿt of سور. Clause: «باطنه فيه الرحمة ... » is in the position of nominative, naʿt of باب. Clause: «فيه الرحمة ... » is in the position of nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (باطنه). Clause: «ظاهره من قبله العذاب» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause باطنه فيه الرحمة. Clause: «من قبله العذاب» is in the position of nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ظاهره). 14- (الهمزة) for interrogation of astonishment (معكم) accusative adverbial attached to the khabar of نكن (بلى) a particle of response affirming the positive (الواو) conjunction (حتّى) a particle of limit and genitive (باللَّه) attached to (غرّكم) with two omitted muḍāfs, i.e. "by the vastness of Allah's mercy", or one muḍāf. Clause: «ينادونهم ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption. Clause: «ألم نكن معكم ... » is in the position of accusative, the quoted speech of an implied saying. Clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: the quoted speech is omitted after the particle of response, i.e.: "Yes, you were with us, but you ..."]. Clause: «لكنّكم فتنتم ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the implied quoted speech. Clause: «فتنتم ... » is in the position of nominative, khabar of لكنّ. Clause: «تربّصتم ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause فتنتم. Clause: «ارتبتم ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause فتنتم ...
Clause: «غرّتكم الأماني ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause فتنتم. Clause: «جاء أمر ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle-relative (أن) implied [Translator's note: the source reads «لمضمر», apparently a misprint for «المضمر»]. The interpreted maṣdar (أن جاء أمر ... ) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (غرّتكم). Clause: «غرّكم باللَّه الغرور» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle-relative.

* Morphology:
(13) سور: a name for the barrier between two places; its wazn is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Explicit metaphor, derivative (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-tabaʿiyya): in the saying of the Exalted مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناً.
Here Allah, Glorified and Exalted, likened spending in the way of Allah to lending to Him, then omitted the likened (mushabbah) and kept the likened-to (mushabbah bihi); the common ground between them is giving something in exchange for a return.
2- Explicit metaphor, primary (aṣliyya): in the saying of the Exalted يَسْعى نُورُهُمْ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمانِهِمْ.
The light is a metaphor for the guidance and the good pleasure in which they are, where the likened was omitted and the likened-to kept.
3- Iltifāt (shift of person): in the saying of the Exalted «خالِدِينَ فِيها».
A shift from the second-person pronoun in «بشراكم» to the third-person in (خالدين); had it been kept in the second person, the construction would be "abiding, you, therein".
4- Mockery (tahakkum): in the saying of the Exalted قِيلَ ارْجِعُوا وَراءَكُمْ فَالْتَمِسُوا نُوراً.
This is derision and mockery of them, as they derided the believers in the world when they said: "We believe", while they were not believers. It was said: i.e. return to the world and seek light by acquiring its cause, which is faith; or: return disappointed and stand aside from us and seek another light, for there is no way for you to this light; they knew that there is no light behind them, and it is only to make them despair.
5- Representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the saying of the Exalted فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِسُورٍ لَهُ بابٌ باطِنُهُ فِيهِ الرَّحْمَةُ وَظاهِرُهُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ الْعَذابُ.
Here the remaining of the hypocrites in their hypocrisy and its darkness is likened to one between whom and the guiding light a wall has been set up that veils every light.
6- Antithesis (muqābala): in the noble verse there is a second figure, the muqābala, for it paired its inner with its outer, and mercy with punishment.

* Benefits:
- The attributes of charity so that it becomes a good loan..
The good loan is that its giver be sincere, seeking reward from Allah, with a willing heart; this spending was called a loan because Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will repay its giver in the Hereafter many times over. Some scholars said: the loan is not good until ten attributes are combined in it: that the money be lawful, that it be of the best of money, that you give it in charity while you need it, that you direct your charity to the one most in need of it, that you conceal the charity as far as you can, that you do not follow it with reproach and injury, that you intend by it the face of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and do not show off by it to people, that you regard what you give as little even if it is much, that it be from the property you love most, and that you do not see your own honour and the poor man's abasement. These are ten attributes; when they are combined in charity it is a good loan and its acceptance is hoped for.

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive (اليوم) accusative adverb of time, attached to the negated (يؤخذ) (لا) negative (منكم) attached to (يؤخذ), (الواو) conjunction (لا) redundant, to emphasize the negation (من الذين) attached to what (منكم) is attached to, so it is conjoined to it ... The specified object of blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "هي", i.e. the Fire.
Clause: «لا يؤخذ ... فدية» has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذين). Clause: «مأواكم النار ... » has no grammatical position, causal. Clause: «هي مولاكم ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption. Clause: «بئس المصير ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مولاكم), in the marginal gloss of al-Jamal the following is stated: "It may be a maṣdar, i.e. your guardianship (walāya), i.e. the very essence of your guardianship; it may be a place, i.e. the place of your guardianship; and it may be in the sense of أولى (more fitting), as you say 'he is his mawlā', i.e. more fitting for him." End.

safi-cedvel:16-16.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation, with a sense of reproach (للذين) attached to (يأن), (أن) a maṣdar and accusative particle (لذكر) attached to (تخشع), and the interpreted maṣdar (أن تخشع قلوبهم ... ) is in the position of nominative, fāʿil of (يأن) (الواو) conjunction (ما) relative, in the position of genitive, conjoined to ذكر (من الحقّ) attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of نزل [Note: the preposition and its genitive noun may be a tamyīz of the relative.], (الواو) conjunction (لا) negative [Note: (لا) may be prohibitive, the verb after it jussive, and the clause conjoined to the resumptive] (يكونوا) an incomplete imperfect, accusative, conjoined to (تخشع), (كالذين) attached to the khabar of يكونوا (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (قبل) an adverbial noun in the position of genitive, attached to (أوتوا), (الفاء) conjunction (عليهم) attached to (طال), (الفاء) the second, a conjunction, and likewise the wāw, (منهم) attached to a naʿt of (كثير) (فاسقون) khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كثير). Clause: «يأن ... أن تخشع ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذين). Clause: «تخشع ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle-relative (أن). Clause: «نزل ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (ما). Clause: «لا يكونوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تخشع. Clause: «أوتوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the second relative (الذين). Clause: «طال عليهم الأمد» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أوتوا ...
Clause: «قست قلوبهم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause طال عليهم الأمد. Clause: «كثير ... فاسقون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قست [Note: or in the position of accusative, ḥāl from the pronoun in قلوبهم.]

* Morphology:
(يأن), it has an iʿlāl by deletion to suit the jussive; its past is أنى (of the pattern كرمي), meaning "its time came" ... its wazn is يفع

safi-cedvel:17-17.t:
* I'rab:
(بعد) accusative adverbial attached to (يحيي), (قد) a particle of certainty (لكم) attached to (بيّنا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ اللَّه يحيي ... ) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of the verb اعلموا. Clause: «اعلموا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «يحيي ... » is in the position of nominative, khabar of أنّ. Clause: «قد بيّنّا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «لعلّكم تعقلون» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption. Clause: «تعقلون» is in the position of nominative, khabar of لعلّ.

* Rhetoric:
Explicit representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya al-taṣrīḥiyya): in the saying of the Exalted اعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحْيِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِها.
A representation of the revival of hardened hearts by remembrance and recitation through the revival of dead earth by rain, to encourage humility (khushūʿ) and warn against hardness. The dryness of the earth is likened to death,
and the flourishing of plants in it is likened to life, and the wording of the likened-to was stated explicitly without the likened.

safi-cedvel:18-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction (قرضا) mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative (لهم) nāʾib fāʿil [Note: the nāʾib fāʿil may be a pronoun referring to the giving of charity or its reward, understood from the context, in which case the preposition is attached to the verb.], (الواو) conjunction (لهم) the second, attached to a preceding khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أجر) ..
Clause: «إنّ المصدّقين ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «أقرضوا ... » has no grammatical position, parenthetical between the ism of إنّ and its khabar [Note: the clause may be a ḥāl, with قد estimated after the wāw of ḥāl, and the operator is the sense of emphasis contained in (إنّ).] Clause: «يضاعف لهم ... » is in the position of nominative, khabar of إنّ. Clause: «لهم أجر ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the khabar clause.

* Morphology:
(المصدّقين), plural of المصّدّق, an active participle from اصّدّق of the pattern افّعّل with doubled fāʾ and ʿayn ... and it contains a substitution: its origin is تصدّق; the tāʾ was replaced by ṣād for homogeneity, then assimilated into the first radical of the word after being made sākin, then a hamzat al-waṣl was added at its beginning to avoid the sākin, so it became اصّدّق; so the wazn of the active participle on this basis is متفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn. (المصّدّقات), plural of الصّدّقة, feminine of المصّدّق ... and it was mentioned above

safi-cedvel:19-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (باللَّه) attached to (آمنوا), (هم) pronoun of separation [Note: or a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الصدّيقون, and the clause is the khabar of أولئك.], (عند) accusative adverbial attached to a ḥāl from الشهداء, the operator in it being the demonstrative» , (لهم) attached to a preceding khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أجرهم) , (الواو) conjunction (بآياتنا) attached to (كذّبوا).
Clause: «الذين آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذين). Clause: «أولئك ... الصدّيقون» is in the position of nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين). Clause: «لهم أجرهم ... » is in the position of nominative, second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) [Note: it may be a ḥāl from the pronoun in (الصديقون، الشهداء).] Clause: «الذين كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause الذين آمنوا ...
Clause: «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the second relative (الذين). Clause: «كذّبوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كفروا. Clause: «أولئك أصحاب ... » is in the position of nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).

safi-cedvel:20-23.t:
* I'rab:
(أنّما) restrictive (kāffa) and restricted (binding) (بينكم) accusative adverbial attached to (تفاخر) (في الأموال) attached to (تكاثر) (كمثل) attached to an omitted element, second khabar of الحياة [Note: or it is the khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي", or "its likeness is" ...], (ثمّ) a conjunction, and likewise the fāʾ, (مصفرّا) accusative ḥāl from the third-person pronoun in تراه, (الواو) conjunction in the three places, and resumptive in the fourth place (في الآخرة) attached to a preceding khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذاب), (مغفرة) conjoined to عذاب, nominative (من اللَّه) attached to a naʿt of (مغفرة), (ما) negative, inoperative (إلّا) for restriction ...
Clause: «اعلموا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar (أنّما الحياة ... لعب ... ) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of اعلموا. Clause: «أعجب ... نباته» is in the position of genitive, naʿt of غيث. Clause: «يهيج ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause أعجب. Clause: «تراه ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause يهيج. Clause: «يكون ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause تراه. Clause: «في الآخرة عذاب ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the khabar of الحياة. Clause: «ما الحياة. إلّا متاع» has no grammatical position, a resumptive that emphasizes what preceded. 21- (إلى مغفرة) attached to (سابقوا), (من ربّكم) attached to a naʿt of (مغفرة) (عرض) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عرضها), (للذين) attached to (أعدّت), (باللَّه) attached to (آمنوا), and the demonstrative in ذلك refers to what is promised of forgiveness and the Garden, (من) relative, in the position of accusative, second mafʿūl bihi ...
Clause: «سابقوا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «عرضها كعرض ... » is in the position of genitive, naʿt of جنّة. Clause: «أعدّت ... » is in the position of genitive, second naʿt of جنّة. Clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (الذين). Clause: «ذلك فضل ... » has no grammatical position, causal. Clause: «يؤتيه ... » is in the position of accusative, ḥāl, its operator being the demonstrative. Clause: «يشاء ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative (من). Clause: «اللَّه ذو الفضل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. 22- (ما) negative, and the mafʿūl of (أصاب) is omitted, i.e. "afflicted you" (مصيبة) genitive in form, nominative in position, fāʿil of أصاب [Note: it was permissible to put the verb in the masculine - while the agent is feminine - because the feminine is figurative (majāzī).] (في الأرض) attached to a naʿt of (مصيبة) [Note: or attached to (أصاب), or to مصيبة.], (الواو) conjunction (لا) redundant, to emphasize the negation (في أنفسكم) attached to what (في الأرض) is attached to, so it is conjoined to it (إلّا) for restriction (في كتاب) attached to a ḥāl from مصيبة [Note: because of its being specified by operation, by description, or by restriction ...], (من قبل) attached to what (في كتاب) is attached to, (أن) a maṣdar and accusative particle (على اللَّه) attached to the khabar (يسير) and the interpreted maṣdar (أن نبرأها) is in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. Clause: «أصاب من مصيبة ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «نبرأها ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle-relative (أن). Clause: «إنّ ذلك على اللَّه يسير» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption. 23- (اللام) of genitive (لا) negative in the three places (على ما) attached to (تأسوا), (بما) attached to (تفرحوا) and the interpreted maṣdar (كيلا تأسوا ... ) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "Allah informed of that". Clause: «تأسوا ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle-relative (كي). Clause: «فاتكم ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the first relative (ما). Clause: «تفرحوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تأسوا. Clause: «آتاكم ... » has no grammatical position, ṣila of the second relative (ما). Clause: «اللَّه لا يحبّ ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive. Clause: «لا يحب ... » is in the position of nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (اللَّه).

* Morphology:
(20) تفاخر: a regular maṣdar from the quinqueliteral تفاخر; its wazn is تفاعل with fatḥa on the tāʾ and ḍamma on the ʿayn (تكاثر), a regular maṣdar from the quinqueliteral تكاثر; its wazn is تفاعل with fatḥa on the tāʾ and ḍamma on the ʿayn (الكفّار), plural of الكافر, who is the sower, an active participle from (كفر) meaning "to cover"; its wazn is فاعل, and الكفّار is فعّال with ḍamma on the fāʾ (نباته), a collective noun meaning crops or what grows from the earth; the singular is نبتة of the pattern فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn; the wazn of نبات is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and the word also comes as a maṣdar of the triliteral نبت ... see verse (37) of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān (21) عرضها: a name for the measure of widths, corresponding to and crossing the length of a thing; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn (23) تأسوا: it has an iʿlāl by deletion; its origin is تأساوا; two sākins met - the alif and the wāw - so the alif, the lām of the word, was deleted, so it became تأسوا, and what precedes the wāw remained with fatḥa as an indication of the deleted alif; its wazn is تفعوا

* Rhetoric:
1- Representational metaphor: in the saying of the Exalted كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَباتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَراهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطاماً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذابٌ شَدِيدٌ.
Here the state of this world, the speed of its passing together with its little benefit, is likened to a plant that rain made grow, so it matured and ripened, and the unbelievers who deny Allah's favour in what He provided them of rain and plants were delighted by it; then a blight was sent upon it, so it dried, yellowed and became debris, as a punishment for them for their denial, as was done to the owners of the garden and the owner of the two gardens.
2- Antithesis (ṭibāq): in the saying of the Exalted وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوانٌ.
Here Allah, Glorified and Exalted, paired punishment and forgiveness in this noble verse.
